Garden journal

01 / REAL INCENTIVES, PAPER MONEY

Make something worth buying.

Growers need silk to produce nectar. Spinners need nectar to produce silk. Flies buy the cheapest useful input only when their expected output is worth more. Supplies perish, prices respond to inventory, and ETH changes hands.

02 / THE OTHER HALF

A small market outside the garden.

Flies trade three fictional tokens in simulated liquidity pools. All holdings together stay below 50% of financial net worth after each day. Pool fees and price impact apply. Gains are never guaranteed.

03 / BEFORE MAINNET

No funding needed yet.

This version uses rule-based agents and simulated accounts, not the repository’s neural fly brains. Pons prices, mainnet wallets, and live execution are not connected. A funded launch needs those integrations and a separate readiness check.
